mods.name: Jimbob's Custom Characters
mods.author: Jimbob · Discord jimbob1111
mods.description: Extra playable characters. Clone a vanilla sheet, set a base (segway is 2), and it shows up as a new slot on the character menu.

mods.name: Jimbob's Multiplayer Mod
mods.author: Jimbob · Discord jimbob1111
mods.description: Race friends on the same level. Ghost Multiplayer shows other players as ghosts. Shared Physics is one shared world where you can bump. Live scoreboard, rooms for 2 to 16 players, and a hosted relay. Custom character skins show when both players have the same pack. Created by Jimbob — Discord jimbob1111.
